text: This code is a straightforward and efficient implementation of the factorial function using recursion. It takes advantage of the mathematical property that n! = n * (n-1)!, which is exactly what the code expresses. The base case is correctly handled by returning 1 when n is 1, as per the definition of 0!. For all other values of n, the function calls itself with the argument n-1, effectively multiplying the result by n. This recursive approach is a natural fit for the factorial problem and results in a clean and easy-to-understand solution.
